name: Control Logics
team_size_estimate: Small boutique; headcount not published. Flat, no-management-layers structure; every consultant has 15+ years of audit experience. Likely well under 40 people, but no LinkedIn headcount could be verified.

startup_focus_evidence.signal: Listed on Secureframe's 'Trusted SOC 2 Audit Firms' hub (described there as having performed security assessments for 200+ companies since 2008 with personalized service) — Secureframe's audience is largely startups.

COUNTER-SIGNAL: the firm's own site markets SOX compliance, Model Audit Rule, ISO, GDPR/CCPA to multi-national and public companies; showcased clients are MarineMax, TradeStation, Primo Water, Cryo-Cell, Heska — not startups. No startup/SaaS/YC-specific marketing found.
SOC readiness page targets service organizations 'new to the process' generally (gap analysis, remediation roadmap, fixed-fee pricing, Director-level involvement), not startups specifically.

grc_partnerships: Secureframe (listed firm on Secureframe's SOC 2 audit firms hub)
services: SOC readiness assessment (gap analysis, remediation recommendations, pre-audit prep)
NOTE: SOC attestation/CPA audit practice was sold to CyberGuard Advantage in August 2024 — Control Logics no longer issues SOC 2 reports itself
partnership_angle: Referral partner with caveats — NOT an auditor-validation partner. CyberGuard Advantage bought Control Logics' CPA/SOC attestation practice in Aug 2024 (accesswire/Yahoo Finance, confirmed by Homan Lajevardi quote), so the firm can no longer sign SOC 2 reports and cannot run the core 'auditor validates, then recommends to pre-audit clients' motion. Its remaining readiness-consulting business partially overlaps with LoxeAI's scan (gap analysis is their billable work). Realistic angles: (a) sandbox tester whose CISA-credentialed consultants use LoxeAI to accelerate their fixed-fee readiness engagements (scan does evidence collection, they do interpretation/remediation), or (b) a door into CyberGuard Advantage, the actual audit shop that absorbed their SOC clients. Score reflects founder-led boutique (+30), Secureframe ecosystem presence (+15), direct founder contact (+10), minus no startup specialization, no AWS signals, 2008 vintage, and the structural mismatch of no longer being an audit firm.
pitch_note: Homan — since the SOC attestation practice moved to CyberGuard Advantage, your readiness engagements live or die on how fast gap analysis gets done. LoxeAI is an AWS-native SOC 2 readiness scanner: run it against a sandbox (or your own environment) on a 30-minute call and see whether it matches what your directors find manually. If it holds up, use it as the first pass on fixed-fee readiness work — clients show up 80% ready, your team keeps the high-value remediation and Director-level advisory, and we'd credit Control Logics on every referred scan.
